entries.summary: School expense cap raised from €800 to €1,000 per student for spese 2025 (730/2026).
E7 mortgage interest codes split by contract year: 7 (through 2021), 48 (2022–2024), 57 (2025, including accollo/subentro/surroga/rinegoziazione).
Home reconstruction 2025: 50% for abitazione principale, 36% for other properties; fossil-fuel boiler replacement excluded.
New riordino delle detrazioni for reddito complessivo above €75,000, on top of the existing 120,000–240,000 phase-out.
Life/disability/LTC/calamity insurance codes split: 36/38/39/43 for contracts through 2024, 51/52/53/54 for contracts stipulated in 2025.
